section_job.evidence: Opening establishes the contrast between international disaster data standards and Thailand's current reporting system, setting up the rationale for MVD.

audience_decision_value.evidence: Gives DCCE executives clear institutional context on why existing DDPM disaster data cannot evaluate real climate loss and damage.

evidence_payload.evidence: Explicitly details DesInventar Data Cards, DaLA Asset-Flow model, 4 DRM phases, relief fund ceiling rules, and 3 specific PDNA rollout roadblocks.

causal_logic.evidence: Clearly links the gap between rapid emergency spending and stalled full-scale PDNA to the compelling need for an operational MVD.
